source: Holmes CTF 2026: The Reichenbach Directive (HTB event 3504, Sept 17-21 2026). Compiled from TheNorthStars-CTF writeups (github.com/TheNorthStars-CTF/Holmes-CTF-2026-Write-ups) and nyaks1/holmes-ctf-2026.
event_shape: 10 numbered Sherlock scenarios, released in drops over 5 days. Each scenario is one evidence bundle with N question-style flags (bare values: paths, hashes, names, coordinates) plus sometimes a final HTB{...} directive flag. ~6,700 teams registered. NOTE: '36 flags' is unverified — documented counts sum far higher.
answer_hygiene: Question-style flags take BARE values (a path, hash, hostname, coords) — do NOT wrap as HTB{...}. Never invent HTB{IOC} wraps. IOC is not a flag. Read the question format before submitting.
